cohort: IVF-conceived infants born less than 32 0/7 weeks gestational age were matched 1:2 to control patients who did not undergo any documented assisted reproductive technology (ART) based on GA, birth weight, and gender, from a large regional, mixed urban and rural population.
finding: Very preterm infants conceived through IVF have similar in-hospital and neurodevelopmental outcomes compared to other very preterm infants.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was similar between the IVF-conceived very preterm infants and the control group.
birth_weight: N/A (used as a matching factor but no specific range provided)
